target_customer: Institutional investors and hedge funds that build and keep Excel financial models
problem: Investment teams keep valuable forecasts in scattered Excel files with no central record, so they cannot track forecast changes or measure projection accuracy.
business_model: B2B SaaS subscription for investment firms
product_category: Financial model repository and equity research tool

founders.name: Will Tong
founders.background_notes: YC page says about a decade in finance, four years in public equities, managed a healthcare equities portfolio at Citadel and was a top 5 analyst in Citadel Global Equities in 2022. Education not listed.

founders.name: Stefan Raghavan
founders.background_notes: Built rockets and drones per the YC page. Education not listed.

competitors.name: Daloopa
competitors.what: Extracts historical financials and KPIs from filings into models for investors
competitors.traction_then: Not stated in the snippet I saw

technical_complexity.rationale: Parsing complex Excel models, versioning them and answering natural language queries linked to source documents needs real engineering and LLM work, but is feasible for two founders.

defensibility.rationale: A repository of a fund's models builds some lock-in, but the data is the client's own and AI Excel tools proliferated quickly.

takeover_risk_then.outcome: Search results show Microsoft later acquired Fintool and AlphaSense acquired the YC company Carousel, both in the Excel and finance AI space. Dates were not verified.

market_need_then: Hedge funds rely on Excel models and lack tooling to version and compare them. This comes from the company's own description. No independent dated spend data was found.

identity.visual_style: unclear, site fetch was rate limited

brand_strength.rationale: A December 2024 trade piece covered the platform launch, but the name is descriptive and generic with no sourced brand assets.

outcome_analysis: Formula Insight is a two person Summer 2024 company that sells a repository for hedge fund Excel models and launched its platform in December 2024. No funding, exit or layoffs were found. Its founders combine buy-side finance and engineering backgrounds, but a wave of funded AI-for-Excel and finance research products makes the wedge contested, and the outcome is still open.
notes: formulainsight.io fetch was rate limited, so the site was not read. No funding source found beyond the standard YC deal, which is not recorded. Daloopa is adjacent (filing data) rather than a direct model repository competitor.
